patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layouts are frequently used, often pairing a large, illustrative graphic on one side with concise text content on the other, creating dynamic visual balance.

A high-contrast typographic system uses extremely bold, wide sans-serif headings for impact, paired with a monospaced font for body text, labels, and subheadings, often in uppercase, to convey a technical yet editorial feel.
The site employs a vibrant, high-contrast color palette dominated by black, white, and a distinctive bright yellow, accented by electric blue and green, creating a bold and energetic visual identity.

The hero section features a large, illustrative traffic light graphic that appears to parallax or scroll at a slower rate, allowing text content to scroll over it. Content sections below the hero reveal with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide as they enter the viewport.
The 'traffic light' and road sign motif is a recurring visual anchor, used prominently in the hero, as section dividers, and integrated into various page layouts across the site.

technique_notes: A sticky header bar transitions from a transparent background to a solid black background with white text and a yellow call-to-action button after the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
The main hero illustration is implemented with a subtle parallax or fixed background effect, where the foreground text content scrolls independently over the slower-moving or static background image.

Scroll-triggered animations, likely using GSAP, are applied to content sections, causing them to fade in and translate slightly upwards as they become visible in the viewport, creating a dynamic reveal effect.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) with smaller, monospaced body text and uppercase labels, creating a strong visual hierarchy.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced — sections are clearly delineated with ample vertical space, and content within sections is well-spaced for readability.

standout: The site's distinctive use of the 'traffic light' and road sign motif as a consistent visual metaphor across the entire experience is highly unique. This playful yet structured imagery, combined with a bold, high-contrast color palette, gives the brand a memorable and unconventional identity that stands apart from generic agency sites.
